from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
payload=json.loads('{"entry": 1581, "assistant": "unwritten new assistant", "receipt": "actual model-action feedback"}')
base=Path('conversation_archive_v1')
entries=base/'entries'
if base.is_symlink() or entries.is_symlink() or not base.is_dir() or not entries.is_dir():
    raise OSError('Archive parents must be existing ordinary directories; no automatic repair')
p=entries/'001581.json'
with p.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False))
print(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
